title: Office Depot Recalls Executive Chairs Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The seat plate weld can break, posing a fall hazard to consumers. Units: About 300,000.

title: Zulily Recalls Children's Pajamas Due to Violation of Federal Flammability Standard (Recall Alert)
summary: The pajamas do not meet the federal flammability standards for children's sleepwear, posing a risk of burn injuries. Units: About 450.

title: KTM North America Recalls Competition/Closed Course Off-Road Motorcycles Due to Fire Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The molded fuel hoses could leak fuel at the radius or the ends of the hose, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 1,800.

title: Britax Recalls Strollers and Replacement Top Seats Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The foam padding on the stroller's arm bar can come off in fragments if the child bites the arm bar, posing a choking hazard. Units: About 49,000 in the U.S. (in addition, 11,000 were sold in Canada).

title: Chillafish Recalls Children's Balance Bikes Due to Laceration Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: Overinflated tires can cause the wheel rims to crack and send pieces of the plastic rim flying, posing a laceration hazard to consumers. Units: About 29,000 (in addition, 268 were sold in Canada).

title: CPSC, NHTSA and Britax Announce Recall of Infant Car Seats Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The car seat carry handle can crack and break allowing the seat to fall unexpectedly, posing a risk of injury to the infant. Units: About 71,000 units (in addition 3,900 units were sold in Canada and 990 units in Mexico).

title: Cheryl & Co. Recalls Jingle Bell Ornaments Due to Laceration Hazard; Sold Exclusively By QVC
summary: The decorative cutouts on the ornament have sharp metal edges that pose a laceration hazard to consumers. Units: About 25,000 box sets.

title: Seasonal Specialties Recalls Synchronized Music and Lighting System Due to Fire Hazard; Sold at Menards
summary: The product can get overloaded and overheat, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 2,000.

title: Walt Disney Parks and Resorts Recalls Infant Bodysuits Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The snaps on the bodysuits can detach, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 10,000.

title: West Elm Recalls Bar Stools Due to Fall Hazard; Sold Exclusively at West Elm
summary: The legs on the stools can break, posing a fall hazard. Units: About 6,000 (in addition, about 100 were sold in Canada).

title: Altar'd State Recalls Monogrammed Coffee Mugs Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The coffee mugs are mislabeled as microwave safe. If microwaved, the metallic paint accents on the coffee mugs can spark, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 14,000.

title: IKEA Recalls Toy Drums and Drumstick Sets Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The rubber ball on the drumsticks can detach or be unscrewed, posing a choking hazard. Units: About 2,000 tongue drums and 1,300 drumstick sets.

title: KTM North America Recalls Husqvarna, KTM Brand Motocross Competition Off-Road Motorcycles Due to Risk of Injury (Recall Alert)
summary: The front wheel spoke assembly can fail, causing the operator to lose control of the motorcycle and crash. Units: About 3,700.

title: School Specialty Expands NeoRok Stools Recall Due to Fall Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The stool can break during use, posing a fall hazard. Units: About 6,000 (About 1,350 were recalled in June 2015. In addition, about 800 were sold in Canada).

title: Steelcase Recalls Chairs Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The screws connecting the seat and back to the base of the chair can detach, posing a fall hazard to the user. Units: About 17,000.

title: QBP Recalls Stolen Series BMX Bicycles Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The bicycles fail to meet the federal bicycle standard. The bicycle's front wheel can detach due to improperly fitting retention washers, posing a fall hazard to the rider. Units: About 1,000 in the U.S..

title: Cost Plus World Market Recalls Tovin Chairs Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The legs on the chair can bend or break, posing a fall hazard to the user. Units: About 1,880.

title: Pier 1 Imports Recalls Swingasan Chairs and Stands Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The suspension hardware on the chair and stand can break, or the stand can become unstable during use, posing a fall hazard. Units: About 260,000 in the U.S. (in addition, about 16,000 were sold in Canada)..

title: Walmart Recalls Rival Griddles Due to Shock Hazard; Sold Exclusively at Walmart
summary: The heating element can crack and water can get inside, posing a shock hazard when the griddle is plugged into an electrical outlet. Units: About 330,000.

title: H-E-B Recalls Stainless Steel Cookware Due to Injury Hazard
summary: The metal discs that cover the cookware's rivets can pop off and hit consumers, posing an injury hazard. Units: About 41,000.

title: i play Recalls Glass Food Storage Cubes Due to Injury Hazard
summary: The glass containers can break unexpectedly, posing a risk of injury. Units: About 68,000 (in addition, about 300 sold in Canada).

title: RNG Recalls 100-Watt Bendable Solar Panels Due to Fire Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The solar panels can overheat, posing a risk of fire. Units: About 1,500 (in addition, about 20 solar panels were sold in Canada).

title: Tristar Products Recalls AquaRug Shower Rugs Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The four suction cups on the underside of the rugs can fail to prevent slipping, posing a fall hazard to the user. Units: About 1.4 million (in addition 70,000 rugs were sold in Canada).

title: Varaluz Recalls Longfellow Light Fixtures Due to Fire Hazard
summary: Improper wiring can allow melting of the insulation and cause the fixtures to short out, posing fire and shock hazards. Units: About 80.

title: Charging Stations Recalled by LocknCharge Technologies Due to Electrical Shock Hazard
summary: A defective USB charging hub can cause an electrical shock to the consumer when the charging station is connected to the electrical supply. Units: About 550.

title: Lunera Recalls LED Lamps Due to Fire, Burn and Electric Shock Hazards
summary: Lamps can overheat, posing fire, burn and electric shock hazards. Units: About 60,000 (an additional 1,000 sold in Canada).
